author: Chris
description: Stress. It makes your heart pound, your breathing quicken and your forehead sweat. But while stress has been made into a public health enemy, new research suggests that stress may only be bad for you if you believe that to be the case. Psychologist Kelly McGonigal urges us to see stress as a positive, and introduces us to an unsung mechanism for stress reduction: reaching out to others.
title: TED - How to make stress your friend; Kelly McGonigal

author: Chris
description:
We have never had to feed as many people as we do today.

How do global food needs affect our lives?

Why are some of the world's largest food producers also countries with the highest rates of undernourishment?

Why do we waste such enormous amounts of food, and how can this be addressed?

Could we all adopt a vegan diet and enjoy good health? And more importantly — should we?

Distinguished scientist Vaclav Smil answers not only these questions. He dismantles myths and explains where our food really comes from.
title: How To Feed The World; Vaclav Smil
